applies_when: Two classes mixed in the same fixed-size point field
Group identity must be decoded from small marks
caption: scatter-small-mark-color/caption.md
mechanism: Small categorical points need visible whole-panel distinction; pale bounded-area colors need not work on tiny borderless marks.
avoid: Pale low-contrast colors fail as small marks on white even though they can be eligible for larger bounded areas.
source_anchors: scWAT Fig.2g PDF p4: blue/pink fitted-line colors adapted here to raw-class marks
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 75 × 70 mm; declared data region: 54.75 × 44.80 mm from the fixed margins.
Two classes share the same coordinate field and mark area; the upper margin reserves space for the two-key categorical legend.
